scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 costume and accessory evidence leads
verification_policy: Keep official category counts separate from item-level identities. Community or mod catalogues may identify likely inventory records but do not by themselves establish acquisition conditions or canonical reward mapping.

sources.scope: Official Chapter 4 count of six costumes and accessories
Community mod catalogue exposing names of Chapter 4 outfit-related records

evidence_leads.name: Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit + Wig among Chapter 4 outfit records.
evidence_leads.pq_mapping: PQ 186 inventory contains Fu (Ultra Supervillain)'s Clothes, Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Set, and Fu Set 2; exact relationship to this catalogue wording remains unresolved.

evidence_leads.name: Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled)
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled).
evidence_leads.pq_mapping: Potentially related to Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled)'s Clothes, but identity equivalence is not asserted without item-level evidence.

evidence_leads.name: Goku's Old Gi
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Goku's Old Gi as a Chapter 4 outfit record.

evidence_leads.name: Super Time Patroller Uniform
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Super Time Patroller Uniform as a Chapter 4 outfit record.

evidence_leads.name: Goku (USV Quelled) Wig
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Goku (USV Quelled) Wig; the PQ 185 inventory independently lists Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) Wig.
evidence_leads.canonical_acquisition: PQ 185 inventory presence is documented; exact reward condition unresolved

evidence_leads.name: Fu (Power to Overcome) Wig
evidence_leads.evidence: Community catalogue explicitly lists Fu (Power to Overcome) Wig.

important_identity_rules: Do not automatically equate the six community-catalogued names with the official six-count category without item-level confirmation.
Do not assume Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Outfit + Wig is identical to any single PQ Set entry.
Do not assume Turtle Hermit Gi (USV Quelled) is identical to Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled)'s Clothes solely from character association.
Do not treat a mod catalogue as proof of canonical acquisition conditions.
Do not infer Normal versus Ultimate Finish ownership from reward ordering.
research_targets: Reconcile the six named community catalogue records against canonical in-game inventory records.
Determine whether Fu Set and Fu Set 2 are set records or shorthand for component equipment.
Determine exact acquisition routes for Goku's Old Gi and Super Time Patroller Uniform.
Determine whether Fu (Power to Overcome) Wig is a separate accessory and its acquisition route.
Map canonical costume/accessory records to PQ 185, PQ 186, story, Ultra Time Patrol Battles, shop, raid, or other sources only when independently evidenced.
nonclaims: No reward-condition mapping is promoted from the community catalogue alone.
No internal item IDs are inferred.
The official six-item count is not used to force an identity match where evidence is incomplete.
